summary: Temporary drone danger area near Huntingdon, Cambridgeshire, with drone flights limited to 400 feet above ground on weekdays from 0800 to 2300.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD288B INSTALLED WI 1.89NM RADIUS OF 
521950N 0001148W (HUNTINGDON, CAMBRIDGESHIRE). BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF 
SIGHT (BVLOS) UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE TDA. MAX HGT 400FT 
AGL. EMERG SERVICES ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN ACCORDANCE WITH 
LOCAL DECONFLICTION AGREEMENTS. OPEN AND SPECIFIC CAT VISUAL LINE OF 
SIGHT (VLOS) UAS OPS ARE PERMITTED WI THE TDA WITHOUT PRIOR APPROVAL 
OR DECONFLICTION. OTHER NON-STANDARD FLIGHT, FLIGHT RESTRICTION ZONE 
OR CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS MUST BE OBTAINED. OPERATORS ARE 
REMINDED OF THEIR RESPONSIBILITY UNDER CAP 722 5.2.2.3 REGARDING OPR 
IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG RESPONSE EFFORT. FOR CREWED ACCESS 
01223 823551 OR PORTAL.AIRSENTRY.UK. FOR INFO AROPS(AT)CAA.CO.UK.
DEC 24-JAN 03 CTC DFR(AT)CAMBS.POLICE.UK. AR-2026-9359/03.
